column5: Temperatures have fallen to extreme levels.
Lakes and oceans begin freezing from the surface.
Humanity is no longer trying to live normally.
After one year, Earth is almost unrecognizable.
The average temperature would be around minus seventy-three degrees.
The surface is covered in ice.
And the only humans still alive may be those sheltering underground, using nuclear or geothermal energy to stay warm.
But Earth itself would not be completely dead.
